summary.description: Optional lead from the agent above the document: what it is and what to look at (plain text).

format.description: markdown: the safe subset (headings, paragraphs, emphasis, inline code, code blocks, lists, quotes, tables, rules, links as text, images by media key). text: plain text, line breaks kept.

doc.description: The document to review. Raw HTML is shown as text; links show their address as text and are never opened.

images.description: Images the Markdown may show with ![alt](key). Anything else, including web addresses, is shown as a quiet placeholder.

key.description: Name used in the Markdown image target.

path.description: Absolute path under a media root (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif).

alt.description: Alt text, used when the Markdown gives none.
